name: Persuasive Theologian
body:
Your study of theology and the scriptures makes you more persuasive.

Prerequisite(s): Knowledge (religion) 5 ranks, must personally possess at least one copy of a book of scriptures relevant to your personal faith.

Benefit(s): For every 5 ranks you possess in Knowledge (religion) you gain a +1 competence bonus to Diplomacy and Performance (oratory) skill checks, so long as the things you are advocating or speaking about are in harmony with your chosen faith.
